name: Deniz Yilmaz
bio:
Deniz's passion for motorsport ignited during his university years while studying mechanical engineering. He immersed himself in Formula Student, leading the team's aerodynamics division and gaining invaluable hands-on experience. After graduating, Deniz joined a smaller racing outfit, honing his skills in data analysis and performance optimization. He quickly proved his ability to extract meaningful insights from complex datasets, leading to tangible improvements on track. 

Driven by a desire to excel, Deniz approaches his role with a pragmatic mindset. He believes in a systematic approach, focusing on data-driven decisions and clear communication within the team. He is known for his ability to identify subtle performance gains and effectively translate engineering concepts into actionable strategies for the drivers. Deniz is eager to contribute his expertise and passion to a team striving for championship success.

His meticulous nature allows him to quickly spot anomalies, while his innate ability to connect with drivers enables him to translate complex engineering concepts into digestible strategies.

physical.description: Deniz is of average height with a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Prefers to work in silence with noise-cancelling headphones.
